{{Top|leg}}
'''People-movers''' were small [[Monorail/Legends|monorails]] that travelled in elevated [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] tubes similar to [[movator]]s. There were two designs of people-mover; the passenger car and the cargo car. [[Minas-Lergo]] manufactured two models &mdash; the [[PM-3B Passenger Car]] and the [[PM-7C Cargo Car]].
